name: Better Workspaces
author: LukasTrust
description: Workspace indicators showing a per-window app icon, plus a full-screen overview to drag windows between workspaces and save/restore whole workspace setups (with optional boot-time restore).

barWidget.description: Workspace numbers plus per-window app icons

schema.label: Icons per workspace
schema.description: How many window icons to show before the rest are counted as +N.

schema.label: Icon size
schema.description: Size of each window icon, in pixels.

schema.label: Workspaces always shown
schema.description: Workspaces shown even while they are empty, counted from 1. Ignored while empty workspaces are hidden.

schema.label: Hide empty workspaces
schema.description: Show only workspaces that have windows in them, plus the one you are on.

schema.label: Group windows by app
schema.description: Show one icon per app, with a count badge once it has 2 or more windows, instead of one icon per window.

schema.label: Game icons
schema.description: Show a game's own icon for Proton-run games that are in your Steam library, including ones launched from Heroic or similar. Native Linux game binaries aren't covered. Resolved once per window class and cached, same as every other icon; turn off to skip that extra lookup entirely.

schema.label: Workspace overview
schema.description: Clicking the workspace you are already on, or the key you bound, opens an overview of every workspace, window and saved setup. Off, a click only ever switches workspace.

schema.label: Opening a setup on an occupied workspace
schema.description: "Add" opens the setup's windows alongside what's already there. "Replace" closes the existing windows first - a normal close request, never a kill, so an app that wants to ask "save changes?" still gets to.

schema.label: Focus after dropping a setup
schema.description: Switch to the workspace a setup was dropped on and close the overview. Off, the focus stays where it was and the overview stays open.
